# tus-upload-server

> Resumable upload server implementing the tus 1.0.0 protocol with creation, termination, expiration and checksum extensions on disk Go module `github.com/Trysac/u921-tus-upload-server`, package `tusuploadserver`, MIT licensed,
> Go >= 1.23, standard library only.

- [AGENTS](AGENTS.md): commands, folder map, conventions, limits
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): shape of the package and its public API
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
